requirements.title: OPEN initiates or modifies a unit-file connection
requirements.definition: An OPEN statement initiates or modifies the connection between an external file and a specified unit; it can connect an existing file, create a preconnected file, create and connect a file, or change certain connection modes.

pending.open-initiates-connection: Create a named file with known content, open it on a chosen unit, and separately reopen the same unit with a changeable mode; assert portable success and that later registered operations use the connection established by OPEN.
pending.open-modifies-connection: Create a named file with known content, open it on a chosen unit, and separately reopen the same unit with a changeable mode; assert portable success and that later registered operations use the connection established by OPEN.
pending.open-connects-or-creates-file: Create a named file with known content, open it on a chosen unit, and separately reopen the same unit with a changeable mode; assert portable success and that later registered operations use the connection established by OPEN.
